fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical commentary on Miami hosting the Shriners convention alongside a convention of prohibition agents, emphasizing civic hospitality, tourism publicity, nightlife, and the economic impact on local businesses. Coverage includes discussion of police department leadership uncertainty and the acquittal of Chief of Police Leslie Quigg, with related crime reporting involving the deaths of Raymond Lee and Philip Lee. The issue also contains local politics and election coverage (including judicial and other offices), letters to the editor, and numerous advertisements and notices for events and services in Greater Miami.
